doc.title: Wayne Bergeron interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 29, 2020

title: What the Buddy Miles band taught him
summary: The band was a pivotal point; saxophonists Brandon Fields and Jeff Jorgensen taught him phrasing and led to later gigs.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Growing up with radio, records and family listening

blocks.x: A one hit wonder. Yeah. Exactly. It was actually a really cool band, and it’s kind of a pivotal point in my career because you know we all kind of looked back, well how did our careers start. And the players I met on that band, two players in particular, one was named Brandon Fields, who is one of the best saxophone players you will ever hear; and then a guy named Jeff Jorgensen, who is also the other great saxophone player you’ll ever hear, who is more unknown. But I’d never heard, I’d never played with any musicians at that point that played at this level. Like these sax players, I said oh my God, I mean just like it was a learning experience for me. And we got to be friends and it made me a better musician playing with them because we would talk about how we were phrasing and they’d go, “No, do that like this.” They’d tell me how to play.
